text:
Dana V: heads-up — recruiters flagged that 5 interviewers disappeared from the scheduler after the overnight offboarding CSV ran.
Ravi S: Which team/req?
Dana V: Multiple teams (growth + infra). IDs show user accounts moved to "inactive" and were filtered out of auto-invite cohorts.
Megan L: Any clue from the offboard job logs?
onboard-bot: [03:12] bulk-offboard: job=offboard-1711239000 completed: 124 succeed, 5 partial-failures
Jon P: Partial-failures usually mean our mapping couldn't reconcile employment_type vs role. Did the CSV include an EmploymentType column?
Dana V: The CSV header was `email,employment_status,employment_type,notes`. Recruiters used `employment_status=inactive` for contractors but left `employment_type` blank. Our job treats any row with `employment_status=inactive` as full deprovision.
Ravi S: Oof. We changed the import logic last quarter to be stricter and accidentally made `employment_type` optional fallback to `employment_status`.
Megan L: Those 5 were long-term contractors with interviewer flag set in ATS; they should not have been deactivated. Interviews are scheduled tomorrow morning.
Jon P: Short-term fix: I'll add a safeguard that skips deprovision if `has_interviewer_role=true` and the last-activity < 90 days. Can push hotfix and run a reversal for the affected user_ids.
onboard-bot: [03:26] detected reversal candidates: user_ids=[u-811,u-842,u-899,u-902,u-911]
Dana V: timeline?
Jon P: 25-30 minutes to deploy reversal script and re-enable accounts, then requeue the scheduler pipeline for impacted panels.
Ravi S: I'll re-export the offboard file and add a column `confirm_deprovision=true` for rows that truly should be offboarded so we can avoid accidental flips.
Megan L: Also add a lightweight preflight that posts a digest to #people-ops showing any row that would disable a user with `interviewer` role.
Jon P: Deployed reversal. backfill job id: rev-1711239999-1 started.
onboard-bot: [03:48] rev-1711239999-1 finished: 5 accounts reactivated, scheduler requeued, 0 failures
Dana V: Confirmed those 5 are back and auto-invite pipeline attached missing interview slots. One interviewer lost availability windows; recruiter is coordinating swaps.
Ravi S: Follow-ups: I'll update the offboard importer to require `employment_type` when `employment_status=inactive`, and require explicit `confirm_deprovision` for anyone with `interviewer` role. Also adding a CSV schema check that posts mismatches to Slack.
Megan L: Please add a note in Recruiting Ops runbook that offboards require ATS user_id and a confirmation column for people with scheduling roles.
Jon P: I'll add unit tests for the deprovision logic and an alert when >0 accounts with `interviewer` are in the offboard queue.
Dana V: Thanks team. Glad we caught it before interviews start. Closing loop :thumbsup:
